info.title: Social Feed
info.description: Authenticated API bodies are limited to 1 MiB, including chunked requests (413). Binary uploads use private S3 presigned URLs.

bearer.description: Production: configured OIDC/JWK RS256 access token with exact issuer, API audience, expiration and canonical lowercase UUID subject. Development HS256 tokens are accepted only in development mode. Unavailable signing-key verification returns 503 with Retry-After; invalid tokens return 401.

Upload.description: Images: at most 10 MiB and 20 megapixels; PNG/JPEG format and full decoder validation at completion. MP4: at most 100 MiB with file-type header validation only; no malware scan or full container/transcode validation.

post.description: Checks declared metadata, validates media bytes against the same ETag used by conditional copy, then freezes the completed object. Invalid images/type headers return 400 and remain incomplete. Retrying a successful completion preserves frozen bytes.
